team.title: The team
team.description1: We are a group of native or bilingual teachers who offer educational paths and activities to learn foreign languages at any age. We also offer workshops to increase your knowledge and seek your psychophysical well-being in a fun, stimulating and lively environment.
team.description2: Teaching is our passion and we are committed to sharing our skills with students of all ages and nations. The needs and requests of students are the starting point for creating specific programs using non-formal methodologies designed specifically for each group.
